description: This source file defines functions for mapping OpenGL format and type pairs to internal formats, and validating ES3 formats, types, and their combinations within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: GetSizedFormatInternal
methods.description: Returns the internal format corresponding to a given format and type pair.

methods.name: ValidES3Format
methods.description: Checks if a given format is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidES3Type
methods.description: Checks if a given type is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidES3FormatCombination
methods.description: Validates if a combination of format, type, and internal format is valid in ES3.
